The tanks are mounted on different levels of the tower, with the top tank on the highest platform, the middle tank on a mid-level platform, and the bottom tank on the ground level.
The structure is located next to a modern two-story building with gray and white walls and windows.
Photo 1 is a silhouette of the same tower from a low angle, showing the top platform and the metal framework against a bright sky.
The watermark 'TUNDE JACOB POSTED ON JIJI' is visible on both photos.

The tanks appear to be made of black plastic or polyethylene, commonly used for water storage.
